title: Strong enough to move the couch yourself: the 4 moves that build it
caption: Strong enough to move furniture on your own, with four moves and no equipment: Wall Sit, Reverse Lunge, Wall Push-Up and Full Plank. Two rounds a day, about ten minutes, and it takes weeks, not days. Save this for the day you rearrange the room.

overlays.text: Strong enough to move the couch yourself. Start here.

scenes.footer: The legs that drive the couch across the room.

overlays.text: Wall Sit. 30 second hold. Back flat on the wall, slide down, hold and breathe.

scenes.footer: The step behind the push. One foot back, then drive.

overlays.text: Reverse Lunge. 6 each side. Step one foot back, lower the knee, stand up.

scenes.footer: The push itself. Arms that press and keep pressing.

overlays.text: Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, lower your chest, press back.

scenes.footer: Holding it all in line while your legs and arms work.

overlays.text: Full Plank. 30 second hold. On your forearms and toes, body in one straight line.

scenes.footer: Two rounds of the four, about ten minutes a day.

overlays.text: This takes weeks, not days. Then one Saturday you push it across the room yourself.

scenes.footer: Save this for the day you rearrange the room.
